notes: Analysis rules, abstract domains, inputs, and recorded results retain their original meanings.
New command-line entry points select the paper cases and write new outputs under runs.
Dependency paths are arguments or environment variables rather than workstation-specific constants.
The Em3d adapter constant was renamed INPUT_DIR and descriptive messages were reworded; the built-in frozenset and propagation operations are unchanged.
The RPC partition implementation used by the paper is included under artifact/real for a self-contained import.
